title: Diweddariad Cysylltedd y Cenhedloedd: Gwanwyn 2026
findings: The official Welsh Spring 2026 update page has a 'Lawrlwytho'r data' section for downloadable source data.
The fixed broadband row groups 'Fixed broadband coverage' with 'Full fibre take-up for local and unitary authorities'.
That row lists the downloadable package as 'Fixed_broadband_coverage_and_full_fibre_take-up (ZIP, 32.2 MB)'.
Mobile coverage is listed separately as 'Mobile_coverage_r1 (ZIP, 254 KB)', confirming the target fixed-broadband package is a distinct archive family.
relevance_to_first_missing_criterion: Official localized download-table validation only. It confirms the current Spring 2026 fixed-broadband/full-fibre archive family and displayed size, but does not expose the corrected-r2 archive bytes, SHA-256, CRCs, or exact 121 postcode member set.
